name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 15 - Am 83
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 15a. Demands that funding for Union propaganda that undermines the national sovereignty of Member States be reduced and, while supporting culture and creativity in general, opposes the spread of “woke” ideology by several media companies across Europe funded by Union funds;
